The '''third moon of Vassek''' [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Vassek/Legends|Vassek]]. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] had a [[Grievous's castle/Legends|castle]] on the moon.

==History==
[[File:Fisto_over_Vassek.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] arrives at the Vassek system.]]
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] allowed the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to track [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] to the third moon of [[Vassek/Legends|Vassek]], though the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] actually was not there. Dooku intended to test Grievous's competence to continue leading the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|armies]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="LOG" />

The Jedi soon learned of Dooku's manipulations, but could not pass the opportunity to [[Mission to Grievous's castle/Legends|apprehend]] or eliminate the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] general. All but [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] were killed, and knowing he could not defeat Grievous and his [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|MagnaGuards]], Fisto fled the moon.<ref name="LOG" />
